headline: Eos reports audited Q2 2026: revenue $68.8M (80% related-party), FY guidance cut to $300–350M, Frontier Power USA JV closed
summary: Total revenue $68.8M (+351% YoY) — but $55.0M (80%) was a single Cerberus-financed related-party project contributed to FPUSA at its Aug 4 close; third-party revenue was $13.7M, down ~10% YoY. Gross margin −71% (gross loss $48.8M); GAAP operating loss −$83.8M; adjusted EBITDA loss −$71.4M; net loss −$275.7M (mostly non-cash mark-to-market). Cash $364.1M incl. restricted at Jun 30; H1 operating burn −$191.8M. Backlog a record $807M (3.4 GWh). Eos cut the top of FY2026 revenue guidance to $300–350M (from $300–400M) and will consolidate manufacturing into Thorn Hill. Positives: FPUSA JV formally closed Aug 4 (~$263M funded, >$1B deployable) and a $100M Blanquilla Phase I PO landed post-quarter.

headline: Eos lists rights-offering warrants on Nasdaq as EOSEW; rights offering settles
summary: Eos filed a Form 8-A12B and a Nasdaq listing certification on Aug 3, 2026 to register the ~3,021,234 rights-offering warrants (exercise price $5.481, 10-year term) for trading as EOSEW — clearing the “listing not assured” caveat from the Jul 23 results. The same day was the expected settlement of the offering, distributing 6,885,218 new shares (+2.0%) plus the warrants via Broadridge. The rights raised ~$37.7M (25.2% take-up); combined with Hudson Bay and Cerberus, total funding for Frontier Power USA is ~$263M. EOSE closed +10.9% at $3.75, two days ahead of full audited Q2 results on Aug 5.

headline: Eos Energy Announces Expiration and Results of Rights Offering — 25.2% take-up, ~$37.7M raised
summary: Holders subscribed for 6,885,218 of the 27,367,171 units distributed at $5.481 — a 25.2% take-up raising ~$37.7M gross against the ~$150M maximum; 20,481,953 units expired worthless at 5pm ET Jul 21. Subscribers paid a 37.7% premium to the $3.98 Jul 22 close, suggesting pro-rata defence rather than price-driven demand. Settlement on or about Aug 3; ~3.02M warrants at $5.481 to be issued and submitted for Nasdaq listing as EOSEW (approval not assured). Including Hudson Bay and Cerberus, Eos says ~$263M gross is now raised for Frontier Power USA — above target and enough to initially support $1B+ of deployable project capital.

headline: Eos Energy Selected to Deliver Mission-Ready Power for "Golden Dome for America" (U.S. Department of War)
summary: The U.S. Department of War selected Eos under the Golden Dome for America missile-defense initiative to deploy a Z3 zinc-based long-duration storage prototype at a critical defense installation. Leans on Z3's ~91% domestic content, Section 842 NDAA + FEOC compliance and non-flammable safety. A strategically important new defense demand vector — but a prototype selection of undisclosed (multi-million-dollar) size, not yet a large booked order.

headline: Eos pre-announces preliminary Q2: record revenue $68–69M, record ~$807M backlog, margin loss −69/−73%
summary: Preliminary, unaudited Q2 (ended Jun 30): record revenue of $68–69M on a >3× YoY jump in shipments; RECORD backlog ~$807M (+25% QoQ); gross-margin loss narrowing to −69% to −73% (from −78% in Q1); total cash incl. restricted ~$364M (collections ~$78M exceeded revenue). First quarter with both lines commercial — Line 2 ahead of Line 1 on yield/cycle time. Full audited Q2 + call moved to Aug 5.

headline: Frontier Power USA Converts 920 MWh Battery Storage Project Portfolio Under Stella Strategic Framework
summary: FPUSA converted a 920 MWh portfolio (Blanquilla, Aransas Pass, Nash, Wallis) under its Stella Energy Solutions framework — further reservation-to-pipeline conversion in ERCOT. Total FPUSA pipeline cited at ~16 GWh (~2.7 GWh high-probability); closing contingent on the rights-offering funding.

headline: Ofgem LDES Window 1 minded-to decisions — only 16 of 73 projects provisionally awarded; Frontier UK largely excluded
summary: Provisional cap & floor awards skew to pumped hydro + long-duration; of Frontier UK's ~16 projects (~2.6 GW, all 8-hour) only one — Frontier Legacy, 65 MW — made the provisional list. The 'VFB/Zn' category does not confirm Eos vs Invinity tech. Consultation to Aug 7; final awards Autumn 2026.
